stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看患儿病历，并回答病例题。

title.en: Suspected nonaccidental trauma in a toddler with occult fractures and inconsistent caregiver history
title.zh: 幼儿疑似非意外性创伤：隐匿性骨折伴照护者病史不一致

summary.en: A 22-month-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his mother's boyfriend after a reported fall from a couch. The child has left arm pain, patterned bruising in concerning locations, and later imaging reveals occult healing fractures in addition to the acute injury.
summary.zh: 一名22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊，据称从沙发跌落。患儿左臂疼痛，并有位于可疑部位的图案性瘀伤；后续影像除急性损伤外，还发现隐匿的愈合期骨折。

content.en:
Background: 22-month-old boy brought by mother's boyfriend, who reports the child fell off a couch onto carpet about 1 hour ago and will not stop crying. The mother is at work and has not yet been contacted. The boyfriend reports being the primary daytime caregiver for about 3 months. No known bleeding disorder, metabolic bone disease, or significant past medical history. Immunizations are up to date per state registry. No prior CPS involvement is documented.

Orders placed: skeletal survey, CT head without contrast, BMP, CBC with differential, coagulation studies, AST/ALT, lipase, urinalysis, continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring, and peripheral IV.

Caregiver statements: The boyfriend says the child is "always a crybaby" and "does this for attention." He reports no loss of consciousness, vomiting, or seizure activity and initially declines to call the mother.
content.zh:
背景：22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊。男友称患儿约1小时前从沙发跌到地毯上，之后一直哭闹。母亲正在上班，尚未被联系。男友称自己约3个月来是白天主要照护者。患儿无已知出血性疾病、代谢性骨病或重要既往病史。州登记显示免疫接种已按时完成。系统中无既往儿童保护服务（CPS）介入记录。

已开立医嘱：骨骼系统筛查X线、头颅CT平扫、基础代谢面板、全血细胞计数及分类、凝血功能、AST/ALT、脂肪酶、尿液分析、连续心肺监测和外周静脉通路。

照护者陈述：男友说患儿“总是爱哭”“这样是为了引人注意”。他否认患儿有意识丧失、呕吐或癫痫样发作，并起初拒绝联系母亲。

title.zh: 初始评估与实验室资料

content.en:
Weight 12.4 kg, length 86 cm. T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 152, BP 96/58, RR 28, SpO2 99% on room air.

Neurologic/head: crying but arousable, tracks faces, pupils equal and reactive, anterior fontanelle closed and flat, no hemotympanum, oral mucosa moist, no frenulum tear.

Musculoskeletal/skin: left upper extremity swelling and point tenderness over the mid-humerus with guarding; the child screams and withdraws when palpated. Distal radial pulse intact; capillary refill <2 seconds; fingers pink and warm. Right upper extremity moves freely. Four circular, well-demarcated bruises about 1 cm each on the left lateral chest wall. Two linear bruises about 3 cm and 5 cm on the posterior right thigh. Fading yellow-green bruise about 2 × 3 cm on the left scapular region. Abdomen soft and non-distended; no abdominal or genital bruising. No petechiae.

Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL, Hgb 11.4 g/dL, platelets 312 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.3 mEq/L, creatinine 0.3 mg/dL, glucose 94 mg/dL, calcium 9.8 mg/dL. PT 12.8 seconds, INR 1.0, PTT 28 seconds. AST 34 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, lipase 42 U/L. Urinalysis negative for blood, protein, and leukocyte esterase.
content.zh:
体重12.4 kg，身长86 cm。体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率152次/分，血压96/58 mmHg，呼吸28次/分，室内空气SpO2 99%。

神经/头部：患儿哭闹但可唤醒，能追视面孔，双瞳等大等圆并对光反应，前囟已闭合且平坦，无鼓室积血，口腔黏膜湿润，无系带撕裂。

肌肉骨骼/皮肤：左上肢肿胀，中段肱骨处点状压痛并保护性固定；触诊时患儿尖叫并回缩。远端桡动脉搏动存在；毛细血管再充盈<2秒；手指粉红温暖。右上肢活动自如。左侧胸壁外侧有4处圆形、边界清楚、每处约1 cm的瘀伤。右大腿后侧有2条线状瘀伤，约3 cm和5 cm。左肩胛区有一处约2 × 3 cm、颜色变淡的黄绿色瘀伤。腹部柔软、无胀，无腹部或外生殖器瘀伤。无瘀点。

实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL，Hgb 11.4 g/dL，血小板312 ×10³/µL。钠139 mEq/L，钾4.3 mEq/L，肌酐0.3 mg/dL，血糖94 mg/dL，钙9.8 mg/dL。PT 12.8秒，INR 1.0，PTT 28秒。AST 34 U/L，ALT 28 U/L，脂肪酶42 U/L。尿液分析：无血、无蛋白、白细胞酯酶阴性。

title.zh: 影像结果与照护者动态

content.en:
Skeletal survey: transverse fracture of the left humeral shaft with minimal displacement; healing posterior rib fracture of the left 8th rib with callus formation estimated at 2–3 weeks old; healing classic metaphyseal lesion (corner fracture) of the right distal tibia with early callus formation. CT head is negative for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture.

The boyfriend now states the child "falls a lot" and "bruises easily." When asked about the rib and tibial injuries, he says he was unaware of prior injuries and suggests the child may have hurt himself in his crib. The mother arrives, is visibly upset, and says she was unaware of injuries other than today's. She reports the boyfriend "gets frustrated sometimes" but denies witnessing physical discipline. The child clings to the mother and turns away from the boyfriend. HR decreases to 128 with the mother present.

The ED physician states the injury pattern is highly concerning for nonaccidental trauma and that a mandatory report to CPS is being filed. The boyfriend becomes agitated and says, "You can't just accuse me — kids get hurt all the time."
content.zh:
骨骼系统筛查X线：左肱骨干横行骨折，移位轻微；左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成，估计伤龄2–3周；右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤（角部骨折），已有早期骨痂。头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折。

男友现在称患儿“经常摔倒”“容易瘀青”。问及肋骨和胫骨伤时，他称不知道既往受伤，并推测患儿可能是在婴儿床里弄伤自己。母亲到达后明显难过，称除今天的伤外，她并不知道其他受伤。她说男友“有时会很烦躁”，但否认亲眼见过体罚。患儿紧贴母亲，并转身避开男友。母亲在场后心率降至128次/分。

急诊医生说明该损伤模式高度令人担忧为非意外性创伤，并正在向CPS进行强制报告。男友变得激动并说：“你们不能就这样指控我——孩子总会受伤。”

serialized.zh:
生命体征:
心率 (当前): 128 bpm

content.en:
A CPS investigator arrives and interviews the mother and boyfriend separately with the ED social worker present. When interviewed alone, the mother tearfully discloses that the boyfriend has "grabbed" the child roughly several times. She once saw a bruise on the child's chest about 2 weeks ago, but the boyfriend told her the child bumped into a doorknob. She says she fears he will "lose his temper" if she says anything and asks the nurse, "Can you just not tell him what I said? I'm scared he'll hurt me too."

Hospital security has been notified and the boyfriend is asked to wait in a separate area. The child receives weight-based ibuprofen per order, and orthopedics applies a posterior splint to the left upper extremity. The child is calmer. HR 118, BP 92/56, RR 24, SpO2 99%. FLACC score 4, down from 8 at presentation.

The CPS investigator requests that the child not be discharged until a safety plan is established. The ED physician orders admission to the pediatric unit for further evaluation, pain management, and coordination with CPS and the child abuse team.
content.zh:
CPS调查员到达，并在急诊社工在场的情况下分别访谈母亲和男友。母亲单独受访时哭着透露，男友曾多次粗暴地“抓”患儿。她约2周前曾看到患儿胸部有瘀伤，但男友说是患儿撞到门把手。她表示害怕自己说出来后男友会“发脾气”，并问护士：“你能不能不要告诉他我说了什么？我也怕他会伤害我。”

医院安保已被通知，男友被要求在单独区域等待。患儿按医嘱接受按体重计算的布洛芬止痛，骨科为左上肢上后侧夹板。患儿较平静。心率118次/分，血压92/56 mmHg，呼吸24次/分，SpO2 99%。FLACC评分4分，较入院时8分下降。

CPS调查员要求在建立安全计划前不要让患儿出院。急诊医生下达住院至儿科病房医嘱，以便进一步评估、疼痛管理，并与CPS及儿童虐待团队协调。

title.en: Stage 3: 8 hours after arrival, pediatric unit
title.zh: 第3阶段：到院后8小时，儿科病房

title.en: Child abuse team evaluation and discharge planning
title.zh: 儿童虐待团队评估与出院计划

content.en:
The child abuse pediatrician documents multiple injuries in various stages of healing, a developmentally inconsistent injury pattern, and a history inconsistent with the injury mechanism. The findings are described as highly concerning for inflicted injury/nonaccidental trauma. A follow-up skeletal survey is ordered for 2 weeks per child abuse team protocol to identify additional occult fractures not visible on initial imaging.

The mother is at the bedside and asks, "What's going to happen to my son? Will they take him away from me?" She is tearful and says she feels guilty for not protecting him. The child is resting comfortably. HR 110, BP 90/54, RR 22, SpO2 99%, FLACC score 2. He is taking oral fluids and small amounts of food.

CPS informs nursing staff that a temporary safety plan is established: the boyfriend is not permitted to have unsupervised contact with the child, and the mother has agreed to a safety plan that includes a temporary protective order. CPS asks the nurse to document the child's behavioral responses to each visitor and to notify CPS immediately if the boyfriend attempts to visit. Discharge planning is initiated with the social worker, CPS, and the mother.
content.zh:
儿童虐待专科儿科医生记录：患儿存在不同愈合阶段的多处损伤，损伤模式与发育阶段不一致，病史与损伤机制不一致；这些发现高度提示蓄意损伤/非意外性创伤。儿童虐待团队按方案开立2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线，以识别初次影像未显示的其他隐匿骨折。

母亲在床旁问：“我儿子接下来会怎样？他们会把他从我身边带走吗？”她流泪，并说自己因没能保护他而感到内疚。患儿休息舒适。心率110次/分，血压90/54 mmHg，呼吸22次/分，SpO2 99%，FLACC评分2分。患儿可口服液体并少量进食。

CPS通知护理人员，临时安全计划已建立：男友不得与患儿有无人监督的接触，母亲已同意包含临时保护令的安全计划。CPS要求护士记录患儿对每位访客的行为反应，并在男友试图探视时立即通知CPS。社工、CPS和母亲共同启动出院计划。

stem.en: At initial presentation, before imaging results are available, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在初始就诊时、影像结果出来之前，护士采取哪些行动是合适的？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Stage 1 imaging results are available. For each finding, classify how it should affect the nurse's concern about nonaccidental trauma.
stem.zh: 第1阶段影像结果已出。请判断每项发现对护士关于非意外性创伤疑虑的影响。

stem.en: During Stage 2, the mother discloses fear of the boyfriend and asks the nurse not to tell him what she said. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第2阶段，母亲透露自己害怕男友，并请护士不要把她的话告诉男友。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Complete the statement describing the nurse's appropriate response to the agitated caregiver.
stem.zh: 完成下列语句，说明护士对激动照护者的恰当回应。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the child is stable and a temporary safety plan is in place. Which nursing actions should be included in discharge planning and psychosocial support? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，患儿情况稳定，临时安全计划已建立。出院计划和心理社会支持应包括哪些护理行动？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: At initial presentation, before imaging results are available, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在初始就诊时、影像结果出来之前，护士采取哪些行动是合适的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Continue pain assessment and neurovascular checks of the injured left arm while avoiding unnecessary manipulation.
options.zh: 继续评估疼痛并检查受伤左臂的神经血管状态，同时避免不必要的搬动或牵拉。

options.en: Tell the boyfriend that the bruises prove child abuse and that he caused the injuries.
options.zh: 告诉男友这些瘀伤证明存在虐待，并且就是他造成了损伤。

options.en: Communicate to the ED physician that the patterned bruising and locations are inconsistent with the reported short fall.
options.zh: 告知急诊医生：这些图案性瘀伤及其部位与所述短距离跌落不一致。

options.en: Delay documentation until the skeletal survey confirms whether fractures are present.
options.zh: 等骨骼系统筛查X线确认是否有骨折后，再记录瘀伤情况。

options.en: Document each bruise objectively, including size, shape, color, and exact anatomic location, using a body map if available.
options.zh: 客观记录每处瘀伤，包括大小、形状、颜色和精确解剖位置；如有身体图，应使用身体图。

options.en: Accept the caregiver's explanation because toddlers commonly fall and bruise during play.
options.zh: 接受照护者解释，因为幼儿在玩耍时经常摔倒并出现瘀伤。

correct.en: The initial bruising pattern is a safety and reporting cue even before imaging. Objective documentation, prompt communication to the provider, and ongoing pain/neurovascular assessment protect the child and preserve a clear record without assigning legal guilt.
correct.zh: 即使影像尚未出来，初始瘀伤模式已是安全和报告线索。客观记录、及时告知医师，并持续进行疼痛和神经血管评估，有助于保护患儿并保留清晰记录，同时不作法律定责。

byChoice.en: Precise, objective documentation of bruise size, shape, color, and location supports clinical communication and forensic clarity without drawing a legal conclusion.
byChoice.zh: 准确、客观记录瘀伤的大小、形状、颜色和位置，有助于临床沟通和法医学清晰性，同时避免作出法律结论。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not accuse, determine guilt, or confront the caregiver; that can escalate danger and exceeds the nursing role.
byChoice.zh: 护士不应指控、判断责任或对照护者进行对质；这样可能升级危险，也超出护理职责。

byChoice.en: The injured extremity still needs routine fracture care: pain assessment and distal circulation, movement, and sensation checks.
byChoice.zh: 受伤肢体仍需常规骨折护理：评估疼痛，并检查远端循环、运动和感觉。

byChoice.en: Patterned bruises on the lateral chest wall, posterior thigh, and scapular region are not typical simple fall contact points and should be escalated to the provider.
byChoice.zh: 胸壁外侧、大腿后侧和肩胛区的图案性瘀伤，不符合普通跌倒的典型接触点，应向医师升级沟通。

byChoice.en: Bruising should be documented when observed; waiting can weaken the record and does not protect the child.
byChoice.zh: 观察到瘀伤时就应记录；等待会削弱记录质量，也不利于保护患儿。

byChoice.en: Toddlers do fall, but the pattern, locations, and varying bruise appearance make accepting the explanation without escalation unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 幼儿确实会摔倒，但瘀伤的形态、部位和不同外观提示风险，未经升级处理就接受解释是不安全的。

testTakingStrategy.en: For suspected abuse, separate objective nursing actions from legal conclusions: document, report concerns through proper channels, maintain safety, and continue clinical assessment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到疑似虐待时，要区分客观护理行动和法律结论：记录、通过正确渠道报告疑虑、维持安全，并继续临床评估。

stem.en: Stage 1 imaging results are available. For each finding, classify how it should affect the nurse's concern about nonaccidental trauma.
stem.zh: 第1阶段影像结果已出。请判断每项发现对护士关于非意外性创伤疑虑的影响。

rows.en: Healing posterior left 8th rib fracture with callus formation
rows.zh: 左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成

rows.en: Healing classic metaphyseal lesion of the right distal tibia
rows.zh: 右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤

rows.en: Multiple fractures in different stages of healing with vague, shifting explanations
rows.zh: 不同愈合阶段的多处骨折，且解释含糊、前后变化

rows.en: Negative CT head for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture
rows.zh: 头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折

rows.en: Normal PT/INR/PTT and normal serum calcium

columns.en: Does not explain away the concern or justify delaying the report
columns.zh: 不能解释掉疑虑，也不能作为延迟报告的理由

columns.en: Supports reasonable suspicion and need for safety/reporting actions
columns.zh: 支持合理怀疑，需要采取安全和报告行动

correct.en: Posterior rib fracture, classic metaphyseal lesion, multiple injuries in different healing stages, and inconsistent explanations together support reasonable suspicion and safety/reporting actions. A negative head CT and normal coagulation/calcium results do not erase the concern created by the skeletal findings and history.
correct.zh: 后肋骨折、典型干骺端损伤、不同愈合阶段的多处损伤以及不一致解释，共同支持合理怀疑并需要采取安全和报告行动。头颅CT阴性以及凝血/钙正常，不能消除骨骼发现和病史所造成的疑虑。

byChoice.en: A healing posterior rib fracture in this context is a high-concern skeletal finding, especially because the reported couch fall does not explain an older rib injury.
byChoice.zh: 在此情境下，愈合期后肋骨折是高度可疑的骨骼发现，尤其是所述沙发跌落不能解释较早发生的肋骨损伤。

byChoice.en: A classic metaphyseal lesion with callus formation is highly concerning when the caregiver history does not provide a plausible mechanism.
byChoice.zh: 在照护者病史不能提供合理机制时，带骨痂的典型干骺端损伤高度令人担忧。

byChoice.en: Repeated injuries at different healing stages plus shifting explanations increase concern for inflicted injury and trigger reporting/safety responsibilities.
byChoice.zh: 不同愈合阶段的反复损伤加上前后变化的解释，会增加对蓄意损伤的担忧，并触发报告和安全职责。

byChoice.en: No intracranial injury is reassuring for neurologic status, but it does not negate the skeletal and bruising concerns.
byChoice.zh: 未见颅内损伤对神经状态较为安慰，但不能否定骨骼和瘀伤方面的疑虑。

byChoice.en: Normal coagulation studies and calcium reduce some alternative explanations but do not justify delaying a report when suspicious injuries are present.
byChoice.zh: 凝血功能和血钙正常可减少某些替代解释，但在可疑损伤存在时，不能作为延迟报告的理由。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let one reassuring result cancel out multiple high-concern cues. Weigh the pattern, timing, developmental plausibility, and consistency of the history.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要让一个看似安慰的结果抵消多个高度可疑线索。要综合损伤模式、时间、发育阶段合理性以及病史一致性。

stem.en: During Stage 2, the mother discloses fear of the boyfriend and asks the nurse not to tell him what she said. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第2阶段，母亲透露自己害怕男友，并请护士不要把她的话告诉男友。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Tell the boyfriend what the mother disclosed so he can respond to the allegation directly.
options.zh: 把母亲透露的内容告诉男友，让他直接回应指控。

options.en: Explain that the team will protect her confidentiality to the greatest extent possible and will not share her specific statements with the boyfriend.
options.zh: 说明团队会在最大可能范围内保护她的保密性，不会把她的具体陈述告诉男友。

options.en: Acknowledge her fear and validate that it was important to disclose safety concerns.
options.zh: 承认她的害怕，并肯定她说出安全担忧是重要的。

options.en: Offer domestic violence resources and continue safety-focused, nonjudgmental support.
options.zh: 提供家庭暴力相关资源，并继续给予以安全为重点、非评判性的支持。

options.en: Advise the mother to confront the boyfriend in the hospital while security is nearby.
options.zh: 建议母亲趁安保在附近时，在医院里当面对质男友。

options.en: Ensure the social worker and CPS investigator know about the domestic violence concern so the safety plan addresses both the child and the mother.
options.zh: 确保社工和CPS调查员了解家庭暴力担忧，使安全计划同时涵盖患儿和母亲。

correct.en: The mother may be a protective caregiver and a victim at risk. The nurse should respond therapeutically, protect confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator as much as possible, involve the appropriate safety-planning team, and provide resources. Confrontation or disclosure to the boyfriend can increase danger.
correct.zh: 母亲可能既是保护性照护者，也可能是处于危险中的受害者。护士应以治疗性沟通回应，尽可能避免向疑似施害者透露她的具体陈述，联系适当的安全计划团队，并提供资源。对质或向男友透露内容可能增加危险。

byChoice.en: Sharing the mother's statement with the boyfriend could escalate danger and is not part of the nurse's role.
byChoice.zh: 把母亲的陈述告诉男友可能升级危险，也不是护士的职责。

byChoice.en: Confidentiality should be protected as much as possible; the boyfriend does not need the mother's specific statements for the nurse to maintain safety and reporting duties.
byChoice.zh: 应尽可能保护保密性；护士维持安全和报告职责，并不需要让男友知道母亲的具体陈述。

byChoice.en: CPS and social work need the disclosure to build a safety plan that addresses risk to both the child and the mother.
byChoice.zh: CPS和社工需要了解该披露，才能制定同时处理患儿和母亲风险的安全计划。

byChoice.en: Validation supports disclosure, reduces shame, and keeps the focus on safety rather than blame.
byChoice.zh: 给予肯定有助于支持披露、减轻羞耻感，并把重点放在安全而非责备上。

byChoice.en: Domestic violence resources and nonjudgmental support are appropriate nursing interventions after a disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 在披露家庭暴力担忧后，提供相关资源和非评判性支持是恰当的护理干预。

byChoice.en: Encouraging confrontation can increase risk; safety planning should be coordinated through trained staff and protective agencies.
byChoice.zh: 鼓励对质可能增加风险；安全计划应由受过训练的工作人员和保护机构协调。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a client or caregiver discloses interpersonal violence, prioritize safety, confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator, validation, and referral to trained resources.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者或照护者披露人际暴力时，优先考虑安全、避免向疑似施害者泄密、给予肯定，并转介到受过训练的资源。

stem.en: Complete the statement describing the nurse's appropriate response to the agitated caregiver.
stem.zh: 完成下列语句，说明护士对激动照护者的恰当回应。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should explain that the CPS report is based on {{1}}, and should avoid {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应说明，向CPS报告是基于 {{1}}，并应避免 {{2}}。

options.en: reasonable suspicion and a legal reporting obligation, not a hospital determination of guilt
options.zh: 合理怀疑和法定报告义务，而不是医院对责任的判定

options.en: the mother's permission to involve protective services
options.zh: 母亲同意联系保护服务机构

options.en: definitive proof that the caregiver intentionally injured the child
options.zh: 照护者故意伤害患儿的确凿证明

options.en: asking security for assistance if behavior threatens safety
options.zh: 如果其行为威胁安全，向安保请求协助

options.en: debating guilt, confronting him with accusations, or attempting a forensic interview
options.zh: 辩论责任、以指控方式对质，或试图进行法医式访谈

options.en: documenting his statements verbatim in the medical record
options.zh: 在病历中逐字记录他的陈述

correct.en: Mandatory reporting is triggered by reasonable suspicion and safety concerns; it is not the nurse's role to prove abuse, determine guilt, or conduct an interrogation. The nurse should remain calm, explain the duty to report, document objectively, and preserve safety.
correct.zh: 强制报告由合理怀疑和安全担忧触发；护士的职责不是证明虐待、判定责任或进行审问。护士应保持冷静，解释报告义务，客观记录，并维护安全。

byChoice.en: The correct trigger is reasonable suspicion and mandated reporting, not definitive proof, legal guilt, or caregiver permission.
byChoice.zh: 正确触发条件是合理怀疑和强制报告，而不是确凿证明、法律责任判定或照护者同意。

byChoice.en: The nurse should avoid confrontation and forensic interviewing; objective documentation and safety escalation remain appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 护士应避免对质和法医式访谈；客观记录和安全升级处理仍然合适。

testTakingStrategy.en: For legal/ethical nursing questions, identify the nurse's actual role: report reasonable suspicion, document facts, maintain safety, and leave investigation or guilt determination to the appropriate agencies.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理法律/伦理类护理题时，要明确护士的实际职责：报告合理怀疑、记录事实、维护安全，把调查或责任判定交给相应机构。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the child is stable and a temporary safety plan is in place. Which nursing actions should be included in discharge planning and psychosocial support? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，患儿情况稳定，临时安全计划已建立。出院计划和心理社会支持应包括哪些护理行动？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Teach the mother the need for the follow-up skeletal survey in 2 weeks and orthopedic follow-up for the humeral fracture.
options.zh: 向母亲说明2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线以及肱骨骨折骨科随访的必要性。

options.en: Give honest, supportive information that CPS's goal is child safety and reinforce the mother's protective actions.
options.zh: 诚实而支持性地说明CPS的目标是儿童安全，并强化母亲正在采取的保护性行动。

options.en: Limit discharge teaching to splint care because CPS is responsible for all safety and psychosocial issues.
options.zh: 将出院教育仅限于夹板护理，因为所有安全和心理社会问题都由CPS负责。

options.en: Document the mother's emotional state, her statements, and the child's behavioral responses to visitors.
options.zh: 记录母亲的情绪状态、她的陈述，以及患儿对访客的行为反应。

options.en: Coordinate with social work and CPS so community resources and the safety plan are confirmed before discharge.
options.zh: 与社工和CPS协调，确保出院前社区资源和安全计划已确认。

options.en: Reassure the mother that CPS will not remove the child as long as she cooperates with the plan.
options.zh: 安慰母亲：只要她配合计划，CPS就不会带走孩子。

correct.en: Discharge planning must address the medical injury, scheduled reevaluation for occult fractures, psychosocial support, objective documentation, and the safety plan. The nurse should support the mother without making promises about CPS decisions and should not narrow teaching to orthopedic care alone.
correct.zh: 出院计划必须涵盖医疗损伤、隐匿骨折复查、心理社会支持、客观记录和安全计划。护士应支持母亲，但不能承诺CPS的决定，也不能把教育只缩小到骨科护理。

byChoice.en: Focusing only on the splint ignores safety planning, psychosocial support, and required follow-up for occult injuries.
byChoice.zh: 只关注夹板护理会忽略安全计划、心理社会支持和隐匿损伤所需随访。

byChoice.en: Honest support reduces guilt and anxiety while keeping the focus on the child's safety and the mother's protective behavior.
byChoice.zh: 诚实支持可减轻内疚和焦虑，同时把重点放在儿童安全和母亲的保护性行为上。

byChoice.en: The nurse cannot promise what CPS will decide; over-reassurance is misleading and may damage trust.
byChoice.zh: 护士不能承诺CPS会作出什么决定；过度保证会误导家属并可能损害信任。

byChoice.en: The 2-week follow-up skeletal survey and orthopedic follow-up are explicit parts of the medical plan and must be understood before discharge.
byChoice.zh: 2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线和骨科随访是医疗计划的明确组成部分，出院前必须让照护者理解。

byChoice.en: Safe discharge requires coordination with social work and CPS, not isolated bedside teaching.
byChoice.zh: 安全出院需要与社工和CPS协调，而不是只靠床旁教育。

byChoice.en: Objective documentation of caregiver statements and the child's behavioral responses supports continuity of care and safety monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 客观记录照护者陈述和患儿行为反应，有助于护理连续性和安全监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge after suspected abuse, think beyond the physical injury: safety plan, follow-up, resources, caregiver support, and objective documentation all matter.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 疑似虐待后的出院计划不能只看身体损伤：安全计划、随访、资源、照护者支持和客观记录都很重要。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
查看患儿病历，并回答病例题。
Suspected nonaccidental trauma in a toddler with occult fractures and inconsistent caregiver history
幼儿疑似非意外性创伤：隐匿性骨折伴照护者病史不一致

A 22-month-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his mother's boyfriend after a reported fall from a couch. The child has left arm pain, patterned bruising in concerning locations, and later imaging reveals occult healing fractures in addition to the acute injury.
一名22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊，据称从沙发跌落。患儿左臂疼痛，并有位于可疑部位的图案性瘀伤；后续影像除急性损伤外，还发现隐匿的愈合期骨折。
Initial emergency department record
急诊初始记录

Background: 22-month-old boy brought by mother's boyfriend, who reports the child fell off a couch onto carpet about 1 hour ago and will not stop crying. The mother is at work and has not yet been contacted. The boyfriend reports being the primary daytime caregiver for about 3 months. No known bleeding disorder, metabolic bone disease, or significant past medical history. Immunizations are up to date per state registry. No prior CPS involvement is documented.

Orders placed: skeletal survey, CT head without contrast, BMP, CBC with differential, coagulation studies, AST/ALT, lipase, urinalysis, continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring, and peripheral IV.

Caregiver statements: The boyfriend says the child is "always a crybaby" and "does this for attention." He reports no loss of consciousness, vomiting, or seizure activity and initially declines to call the mother.

背景：22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊。男友称患儿约1小时前从沙发跌到地毯上，之后一直哭闹。母亲正在上班，尚未被联系。男友称自己约3个月来是白天主要照护者。患儿无已知出血性疾病、代谢性骨病或重要既往病史。州登记显示免疫接种已按时完成。系统中无既往儿童保护服务（CPS）介入记录。

已开立医嘱：骨骼系统筛查X线、头颅CT平扫、基础代谢面板、全血细胞计数及分类、凝血功能、AST/ALT、脂肪酶、尿液分析、连续心肺监测和外周静脉通路。

照护者陈述：男友说患儿“总是爱哭”“这样是为了引人注意”。他否认患儿有意识丧失、呕吐或癫痫样发作，并起初拒绝联系母亲。
Initial assessment and laboratory data
初始评估与实验室资料

Weight 12.4 kg, length 86 cm. T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 152, BP 96/58, RR 28, SpO2 99% on room air.

Neurologic/head: crying but arousable, tracks faces, pupils equal and reactive, anterior fontanelle closed and flat, no hemotympanum, oral mucosa moist, no frenulum tear.

Musculoskeletal/skin: left upper extremity swelling and point tenderness over the mid-humerus with guarding; the child screams and withdraws when palpated. Distal radial pulse intact; capillary refill <2 seconds; fingers pink and warm. Right upper extremity moves freely. Four circular, well-demarcated bruises about 1 cm each on the left lateral chest wall. Two linear bruises about 3 cm and 5 cm on the posterior right thigh. Fading yellow-green bruise about 2 × 3 cm on the left scapular region. Abdomen soft and non-distended; no abdominal or genital bruising. No petechiae.

Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL, Hgb 11.4 g/dL, platelets 312 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.3 mEq/L, creatinine 0.3 mg/dL, glucose 94 mg/dL, calcium 9.8 mg/dL. PT 12.8 seconds, INR 1.0, PTT 28 seconds. AST 34 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, lipase 42 U/L. Urinalysis negative for blood, protein, and leukocyte esterase.

体重12.4 kg，身长86 cm。体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率152次/分，血压96/58 mmHg，呼吸28次/分，室内空气SpO2 99%。

神经/头部：患儿哭闹但可唤醒，能追视面孔，双瞳等大等圆并对光反应，前囟已闭合且平坦，无鼓室积血，口腔黏膜湿润，无系带撕裂。

肌肉骨骼/皮肤：左上肢肿胀，中段肱骨处点状压痛并保护性固定；触诊时患儿尖叫并回缩。远端桡动脉搏动存在；毛细血管再充盈<2秒；手指粉红温暖。右上肢活动自如。左侧胸壁外侧有4处圆形、边界清楚、每处约1 cm的瘀伤。右大腿后侧有2条线状瘀伤，约3 cm和5 cm。左肩胛区有一处约2 × 3 cm、颜色变淡的黄绿色瘀伤。腹部柔软、无胀，无腹部或外生殖器瘀伤。无瘀点。

实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL，Hgb 11.4 g/dL，血小板312 ×10³/µL。钠139 mEq/L，钾4.3 mEq/L，肌酐0.3 mg/dL，血糖94 mg/dL，钙9.8 mg/dL。PT 12.8秒，INR 1.0，PTT 28秒。AST 34 U/L，ALT 28 U/L，脂肪酶42 U/L。尿液分析：无血、无蛋白、白细胞酯酶阴性。

Stage 1: 90 minutes after arrival
第1阶段：到院后90分钟
Imaging and caregiver update
影像结果与照护者动态

Skeletal survey: transverse fracture of the left humeral shaft with minimal displacement; healing posterior rib fracture of the left 8th rib with callus formation estimated at 2–3 weeks old; healing classic metaphyseal lesion (corner fracture) of the right distal tibia with early callus formation. CT head is negative for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture.

The boyfriend now states the child "falls a lot" and "bruises easily." When asked about the rib and tibial injuries, he says he was unaware of prior injuries and suggests the child may have hurt himself in his crib. The mother arrives, is visibly upset, and says she was unaware of injuries other than today's. She reports the boyfriend "gets frustrated sometimes" but denies witnessing physical discipline. The child clings to the mother and turns away from the boyfriend. HR decreases to 128 with the mother present.

The ED physician states the injury pattern is highly concerning for nonaccidental trauma and that a mandatory report to CPS is being filed. The boyfriend becomes agitated and says, "You can't just accuse me — kids get hurt all the time."

骨骼系统筛查X线：左肱骨干横行骨折，移位轻微；左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成，估计伤龄2–3周；右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤（角部骨折），已有早期骨痂。头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折。

男友现在称患儿“经常摔倒”“容易瘀青”。问及肋骨和胫骨伤时，他称不知道既往受伤，并推测患儿可能是在婴儿床里弄伤自己。母亲到达后明显难过，称除今天的伤外，她并不知道其他受伤。她说男友“有时会很烦躁”，但否认亲眼见过体罚。患儿紧贴母亲，并转身避开男友。母亲在场后心率降至128次/分。

急诊医生说明该损伤模式高度令人担忧为非意外性创伤，并正在向CPS进行强制报告。男友变得激动并说：“你们不能就这样指控我——孩子总会受伤。”
Heart rate (Current): 128 bpm
心率 (当前): 128 bpm
Stage 2: 3 hours after arrival
第2阶段：到院后3小时
Separate interviews and safety measures
分别访谈与安全措施

A CPS investigator arrives and interviews the mother and boyfriend separately with the ED social worker present. When interviewed alone, the mother tearfully discloses that the boyfriend has "grabbed" the child roughly several times. She once saw a bruise on the child's chest about 2 weeks ago, but the boyfriend told her the child bumped into a doorknob. She says she fears he will "lose his temper" if she says anything and asks the nurse, "Can you just not tell him what I said? I'm scared he'll hurt me too."

Hospital security has been notified and the boyfriend is asked to wait in a separate area. The child receives weight-based ibuprofen per order, and orthopedics applies a posterior splint to the left upper extremity. The child is calmer. HR 118, BP 92/56, RR 24, SpO2 99%. FLACC score 4, down from 8 at presentation.

The CPS investigator requests that the child not be discharged until a safety plan is established. The ED physician orders admission to the pediatric unit for further evaluation, pain management, and coordination with CPS and the child abuse team.

CPS调查员到达，并在急诊社工在场的情况下分别访谈母亲和男友。母亲单独受访时哭着透露，男友曾多次粗暴地“抓”患儿。她约2周前曾看到患儿胸部有瘀伤，但男友说是患儿撞到门把手。她表示害怕自己说出来后男友会“发脾气”，并问护士：“你能不能不要告诉他我说了什么？我也怕他会伤害我。”

医院安保已被通知，男友被要求在单独区域等待。患儿按医嘱接受按体重计算的布洛芬止痛，骨科为左上肢上后侧夹板。患儿较平静。心率118次/分，血压92/56 mmHg，呼吸24次/分，SpO2 99%。FLACC评分4分，较入院时8分下降。

CPS调查员要求在建立安全计划前不要让患儿出院。急诊医生下达住院至儿科病房医嘱，以便进一步评估、疼痛管理，并与CPS及儿童虐待团队协调。
Stage 3: 8 hours after arrival, pediatric unit
第3阶段：到院后8小时，儿科病房
Child abuse team evaluation and discharge planning
儿童虐待团队评估与出院计划

The child abuse pediatrician documents multiple injuries in various stages of healing, a developmentally inconsistent injury pattern, and a history inconsistent with the injury mechanism. The findings are described as highly concerning for inflicted injury/nonaccidental trauma. A follow-up skeletal survey is ordered for 2 weeks per child abuse team protocol to identify additional occult fractures not visible on initial imaging.

The mother is at the bedside and asks, "What's going to happen to my son? Will they take him away from me?" She is tearful and says she feels guilty for not protecting him. The child is resting comfortably. HR 110, BP 90/54, RR 22, SpO2 99%, FLACC score 2. He is taking oral fluids and small amounts of food.

CPS informs nursing staff that a temporary safety plan is established: the boyfriend is not permitted to have unsupervised contact with the child, and the mother has agreed to a safety plan that includes a temporary protective order. CPS asks the nurse to document the child's behavioral responses to each visitor and to notify CPS immediately if the boyfriend attempts to visit. Discharge planning is initiated with the social worker, CPS, and the mother.

儿童虐待专科儿科医生记录：患儿存在不同愈合阶段的多处损伤，损伤模式与发育阶段不一致，病史与损伤机制不一致；这些发现高度提示蓄意损伤/非意外性创伤。儿童虐待团队按方案开立2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线，以识别初次影像未显示的其他隐匿骨折。

母亲在床旁问：“我儿子接下来会怎样？他们会把他从我身边带走吗？”她流泪，并说自己因没能保护他而感到内疚。患儿休息舒适。心率110次/分，血压90/54 mmHg，呼吸22次/分，SpO2 99%，FLACC评分2分。患儿可口服液体并少量进食。

CPS通知护理人员，临时安全计划已建立：男友不得与患儿有无人监督的接触，母亲已同意包含临时保护令的安全计划。CPS要求护士记录患儿对每位访客的行为反应，并在男友试图探视时立即通知CPS。社工、CPS和母亲共同启动出院计划。

At initial presentation, before imaging results are available, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
在初始就诊时、影像结果出来之前，护士采取哪些行动是合适的？选择所有适用项。
Continue pain assessment and neurovascular checks of the injured left arm while avoiding unnecessary manipulation.
继续评估疼痛并检查受伤左臂的神经血管状态，同时避免不必要的搬动或牵拉。
Tell the boyfriend that the bruises prove child abuse and that he caused the injuries.
告诉男友这些瘀伤证明存在虐待，并且就是他造成了损伤。
Communicate to the ED physician that the patterned bruising and locations are inconsistent with the reported short fall.
告知急诊医生：这些图案性瘀伤及其部位与所述短距离跌落不一致。
Delay documentation until the skeletal survey confirms whether fractures are present.
等骨骼系统筛查X线确认是否有骨折后，再记录瘀伤情况。
Document each bruise objectively, including size, shape, color, and exact anatomic location, using a body map if available.
客观记录每处瘀伤，包括大小、形状、颜色和精确解剖位置；如有身体图，应使用身体图。
Accept the caregiver's explanation because toddlers commonly fall and bruise during play.
接受照护者解释，因为幼儿在玩耍时经常摔倒并出现瘀伤。

The initial bruising pattern is a safety and reporting cue even before imaging. Objective documentation, prompt communication to the provider, and ongoing pain/neurovascular assessment protect the child and preserve a clear record without assigning legal guilt.
即使影像尚未出来，初始瘀伤模式已是安全和报告线索。客观记录、及时告知医师，并持续进行疼痛和神经血管评估，有助于保护患儿并保留清晰记录，同时不作法律定责。
Precise, objective documentation of bruise size, shape, color, and location supports clinical communication and forensic clarity without drawing a legal conclusion.
准确、客观记录瘀伤的大小、形状、颜色和位置，有助于临床沟通和法医学清晰性，同时避免作出法律结论。
The nurse should not accuse, determine guilt, or confront the caregiver; that can escalate danger and exceeds the nursing role.
护士不应指控、判断责任或对照护者进行对质；这样可能升级危险，也超出护理职责。
The injured extremity still needs routine fracture care: pain assessment and distal circulation, movement, and sensation checks.
受伤肢体仍需常规骨折护理：评估疼痛，并检查远端循环、运动和感觉。
Patterned bruises on the lateral chest wall, posterior thigh, and scapular region are not typical simple fall contact points and should be escalated to the provider.
胸壁外侧、大腿后侧和肩胛区的图案性瘀伤，不符合普通跌倒的典型接触点，应向医师升级沟通。
Bruising should be documented when observed; waiting can weaken the record and does not protect the child.
观察到瘀伤时就应记录；等待会削弱记录质量，也不利于保护患儿。
Toddlers do fall, but the pattern, locations, and varying bruise appearance make accepting the explanation without escalation unsafe.
幼儿确实会摔倒，但瘀伤的形态、部位和不同外观提示风险，未经升级处理就接受解释是不安全的。
For suspected abuse, separate objective nursing actions from legal conclusions: document, report concerns through proper channels, maintain safety, and continue clinical assessment.
遇到疑似虐待时，要区分客观护理行动和法律结论：记录、通过正确渠道报告疑虑、维持安全，并继续临床评估。
Stage 1 imaging results are available. For each finding, classify how it should affect the nurse's concern about nonaccidental trauma.
第1阶段影像结果已出。请判断每项发现对护士关于非意外性创伤疑虑的影响。
Healing posterior left 8th rib fracture with callus formation
左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成
Healing classic metaphyseal lesion of the right distal tibia
右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤
Multiple fractures in different stages of healing with vague, shifting explanations
不同愈合阶段的多处骨折，且解释含糊、前后变化
Negative CT head for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture
头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折
Normal PT/INR/PTT and normal serum calcium
PT/INR/PTT正常，血钙正常
Does not explain away the concern or justify delaying the report
不能解释掉疑虑，也不能作为延迟报告的理由
Supports reasonable suspicion and need for safety/reporting actions
支持合理怀疑，需要采取安全和报告行动

Posterior rib fracture, classic metaphyseal lesion, multiple injuries in different healing stages, and inconsistent explanations together support reasonable suspicion and safety/reporting actions. A negative head CT and normal coagulation/calcium results do not erase the concern created by the skeletal findings and history.
后肋骨折、典型干骺端损伤、不同愈合阶段的多处损伤以及不一致解释，共同支持合理怀疑并需要采取安全和报告行动。头颅CT阴性以及凝血/钙正常，不能消除骨骼发现和病史所造成的疑虑。
A healing posterior rib fracture in this context is a high-concern skeletal finding, especially because the reported couch fall does not explain an older rib injury.
在此情境下，愈合期后肋骨折是高度可疑的骨骼发现，尤其是所述沙发跌落不能解释较早发生的肋骨损伤。
A classic metaphyseal lesion with callus formation is highly concerning when the caregiver history does not provide a plausible mechanism.
在照护者病史不能提供合理机制时，带骨痂的典型干骺端损伤高度令人担忧。
Repeated injuries at different healing stages plus shifting explanations increase concern for inflicted injury and trigger reporting/safety responsibilities.
不同愈合阶段的反复损伤加上前后变化的解释，会增加对蓄意损伤的担忧，并触发报告和安全职责。
No intracranial injury is reassuring for neurologic status, but it does not negate the skeletal and bruising concerns.
未见颅内损伤对神经状态较为安慰，但不能否定骨骼和瘀伤方面的疑虑。
Normal coagulation studies and calcium reduce some alternative explanations but do not justify delaying a report when suspicious injuries are present.
凝血功能和血钙正常可减少某些替代解释，但在可疑损伤存在时，不能作为延迟报告的理由。
Do not let one reassuring result cancel out multiple high-concern cues. Weigh the pattern, timing, developmental plausibility, and consistency of the history.
不要让一个看似安慰的结果抵消多个高度可疑线索。要综合损伤模式、时间、发育阶段合理性以及病史一致性。
During Stage 2, the mother discloses fear of the boyfriend and asks the nurse not to tell him what she said. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
第2阶段，母亲透露自己害怕男友，并请护士不要把她的话告诉男友。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。
Tell the boyfriend what the mother disclosed so he can respond to the allegation directly.
把母亲透露的内容告诉男友，让他直接回应指控。
Explain that the team will protect her confidentiality to the greatest extent possible and will not share her specific statements with the boyfriend.
说明团队会在最大可能范围内保护她的保密性，不会把她的具体陈述告诉男友。
Acknowledge her fear and validate that it was important to disclose safety concerns.
承认她的害怕，并肯定她说出安全担忧是重要的。
Offer domestic violence resources and continue safety-focused, nonjudgmental support.
提供家庭暴力相关资源，并继续给予以安全为重点、非评判性的支持。
Advise the mother to confront the boyfriend in the hospital while security is nearby.
建议母亲趁安保在附近时，在医院里当面对质男友。
Ensure the social worker and CPS investigator know about the domestic violence concern so the safety plan addresses both the child and the mother.
确保社工和CPS调查员了解家庭暴力担忧，使安全计划同时涵盖患儿和母亲。

The mother may be a protective caregiver and a victim at risk. The nurse should respond therapeutically, protect confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator as much as possible, involve the appropriate safety-planning team, and provide resources. Confrontation or disclosure to the boyfriend can increase danger.
母亲可能既是保护性照护者，也可能是处于危险中的受害者。护士应以治疗性沟通回应，尽可能避免向疑似施害者透露她的具体陈述，联系适当的安全计划团队，并提供资源。对质或向男友透露内容可能增加危险。
Sharing the mother's statement with the boyfriend could escalate danger and is not part of the nurse's role.
把母亲的陈述告诉男友可能升级危险，也不是护士的职责。
Confidentiality should be protected as much as possible; the boyfriend does not need the mother's specific statements for the nurse to maintain safety and reporting duties.
应尽可能保护保密性；护士维持安全和报告职责，并不需要让男友知道母亲的具体陈述。
CPS and social work need the disclosure to build a safety plan that addresses risk to both the child and the mother.
CPS和社工需要了解该披露，才能制定同时处理患儿和母亲风险的安全计划。
Validation supports disclosure, reduces shame, and keeps the focus on safety rather than blame.
给予肯定有助于支持披露、减轻羞耻感，并把重点放在安全而非责备上。
Domestic violence resources and nonjudgmental support are appropriate nursing interventions after a disclosure.
在披露家庭暴力担忧后，提供相关资源和非评判性支持是恰当的护理干预。
Encouraging confrontation can increase risk; safety planning should be coordinated through trained staff and protective agencies.
鼓励对质可能增加风险；安全计划应由受过训练的工作人员和保护机构协调。
When a client or caregiver discloses interpersonal violence, prioritize safety, confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator, validation, and referral to trained resources.
当患者或照护者披露人际暴力时，优先考虑安全、避免向疑似施害者泄密、给予肯定，并转介到受过训练的资源。
Complete the statement describing the nurse's appropriate response to the agitated caregiver.
完成下列语句，说明护士对激动照护者的恰当回应。
The nurse should explain that the CPS report is based on {{1}}, and should avoid {{2}}.
护士应说明，向CPS报告是基于 {{1}}，并应避免 {{2}}。
reasonable suspicion and a legal reporting obligation, not a hospital determination of guilt
合理怀疑和法定报告义务，而不是医院对责任的判定
the mother's permission to involve protective services
母亲同意联系保护服务机构
definitive proof that the caregiver intentionally injured the child
照护者故意伤害患儿的确凿证明
asking security for assistance if behavior threatens safety
如果其行为威胁安全，向安保请求协助
debating guilt, confronting him with accusations, or attempting a forensic interview
辩论责任、以指控方式对质，或试图进行法医式访谈
documenting his statements verbatim in the medical record
在病历中逐字记录他的陈述

Mandatory reporting is triggered by reasonable suspicion and safety concerns; it is not the nurse's role to prove abuse, determine guilt, or conduct an interrogation. The nurse should remain calm, explain the duty to report, document objectively, and preserve safety.
强制报告由合理怀疑和安全担忧触发；护士的职责不是证明虐待、判定责任或进行审问。护士应保持冷静，解释报告义务，客观记录，并维护安全。
The correct trigger is reasonable suspicion and mandated reporting, not definitive proof, legal guilt, or caregiver permission.
正确触发条件是合理怀疑和强制报告，而不是确凿证明、法律责任判定或照护者同意。
The nurse should avoid confrontation and forensic interviewing; objective documentation and safety escalation remain appropriate.
护士应避免对质和法医式访谈；客观记录和安全升级处理仍然合适。

For legal/ethical nursing questions, identify the nurse's actual role: report reasonable suspicion, document facts, maintain safety, and leave investigation or guilt determination to the appropriate agencies.
处理法律/伦理类护理题时，要明确护士的实际职责：报告合理怀疑、记录事实、维护安全，把调查或责任判定交给相应机构。
At Stage 3, the child is stable and a temporary safety plan is in place. Which nursing actions should be included in discharge planning and psychosocial support? Select all that apply.
第3阶段，患儿情况稳定，临时安全计划已建立。出院计划和心理社会支持应包括哪些护理行动？选择所有适用项。
Teach the mother the need for the follow-up skeletal survey in 2 weeks and orthopedic follow-up for the humeral fracture.
向母亲说明2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线以及肱骨骨折骨科随访的必要性。
Give honest, supportive information that CPS's goal is child safety and reinforce the mother's protective actions.
诚实而支持性地说明CPS的目标是儿童安全，并强化母亲正在采取的保护性行动。
Limit discharge teaching to splint care because CPS is responsible for all safety and psychosocial issues.
将出院教育仅限于夹板护理，因为所有安全和心理社会问题都由CPS负责。
Document the mother's emotional state, her statements, and the child's behavioral responses to visitors.
记录母亲的情绪状态、她的陈述，以及患儿对访客的行为反应。
Coordinate with social work and CPS so community resources and the safety plan are confirmed before discharge.
与社工和CPS协调，确保出院前社区资源和安全计划已确认。
Reassure the mother that CPS will not remove the child as long as she cooperates with the plan.
安慰母亲：只要她配合计划，CPS就不会带走孩子。

Discharge planning must address the medical injury, scheduled reevaluation for occult fractures, psychosocial support, objective documentation, and the safety plan. The nurse should support the mother without making promises about CPS decisions and should not narrow teaching to orthopedic care alone.
出院计划必须涵盖医疗损伤、隐匿骨折复查、心理社会支持、客观记录和安全计划。护士应支持母亲，但不能承诺CPS的决定，也不能把教育只缩小到骨科护理。
Focusing only on the splint ignores safety planning, psychosocial support, and required follow-up for occult injuries.
只关注夹板护理会忽略安全计划、心理社会支持和隐匿损伤所需随访。
Honest support reduces guilt and anxiety while keeping the focus on the child's safety and the mother's protective behavior.
诚实支持可减轻内疚和焦虑，同时把重点放在儿童安全和母亲的保护性行为上。
The nurse cannot promise what CPS will decide; over-reassurance is misleading and may damage trust.
护士不能承诺CPS会作出什么决定；过度保证会误导家属并可能损害信任。
The 2-week follow-up skeletal survey and orthopedic follow-up are explicit parts of the medical plan and must be understood before discharge.
2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线和骨科随访是医疗计划的明确组成部分，出院前必须让照护者理解。
Safe discharge requires coordination with social work and CPS, not isolated bedside teaching.
安全出院需要与社工和CPS协调，而不是只靠床旁教育。
Objective documentation of caregiver statements and the child's behavioral responses supports continuity of care and safety monitoring.
客观记录照护者陈述和患儿行为反应，有助于护理连续性和安全监测。
For discharge after suspected abuse, think beyond the physical injury: safety plan, follow-up, resources, caregiver support, and objective documentation all matter.
疑似虐待后的出院计划不能只看身体损伤：安全计划、随访、资源、照护者支持和客观记录都很重要。
